boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented places for studying, recharging, recreation, and campus connection beyond a standard walkthrough.

cards.title: Sprague Library
cards.subtitle: Near Susan A. Cole Hall
cards.notes: Start on the main level for lending and research help, then use the posted floor maps to choose a quieter study area or a reservable room.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level library with study areas, media resources, and lending services.
cards.evidence_claim: The library tour identifies study areas on every level, group and collaborative rooms, and main-level laptop lending.
cards.access_notes: University Libraries states that Sprague Library is open to visitors; some services and reservable spaces have eligibility rules.

cards.title: Commuter Study Space
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library, first-floor south wing
cards.notes: Bring a charger and settle in near the Print and Laptop Lending Lab; use the large table or height-adjustable tables for an extended work session.
cards.short_summary: A bright library room with outlets, varied furniture, and a group table.
cards.evidence_claim: The Libraries page places the Commuter Study Space on Sprague Library’s first-floor south wing and lists outlets, a group table, and height-adjustable tables.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a drop-in study area during library operating hours.

cards.title: The Sensory Space
cards.subtitle: Room 030, Sprague Library Multimedia area
cards.notes: Reserve a two-hour session when a calmer setting would help; keep calls elsewhere, since Zoom calls are not permitted in this space.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, sensory-supportive retreat with privacy seating and comfort tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Libraries page describes Room 030 as a dedicated sensory-supportive retreat and states that it can be booked for up to two hours.
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; the page says Zoom calls are not permitted.

cards.entity_name: Cole Hall Overlook Silent Study Space
cards.title: Cole Hall Overlook Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library upper level, overlooking Cole Hall
cards.notes: Use this upper-level desk area when you need a quiet reading or writing block; choose it over group rooms when conversation is not part of the task.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent study area with a view toward Cole Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Libraries study-spaces page identifies a large silent and quiet study area on the upper level overlooking Cole Hall.
cards.access_notes: Drop-in library study area during library operating hours.

cards.title: Creative Collaboration Pod
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library collaborative space
cards.notes: Reserve this pod for a project meeting that needs a shared screen and writable surface; arrive with your group’s files and a clear agenda.
cards.short_summary: A library pod designed for group assignments, media projects, and video conferencing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Libraries page lists the Creative Collaboration Pod among spaces for group assignments, media projects, or video conferencing, with a monitor and whiteboard wall.
cards.access_notes: Reservable collaborative space for students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Student Center
cards.subtitle: Campus hub for services, dining, and meeting space
cards.notes: Use the building directory to locate services, lounges, meeting rooms, or the cafeteria; it is a practical starting point before heading to a campus event.
cards.short_summary: A central building combining student services, dining, lounges, and program rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center’s official listing includes dining, student-service offices, lounges, ballrooms, meeting rooms, and outdoor spaces.
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Center for current building and event access details.

cards.title: Red Hawk Nest
cards.subtitle: Student Center Annex, Room 126
cards.notes: Meet classmates in this designated lounge before an activity or between classes; pair it with nearby Student Engagement and student-organization offices in the Annex.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Center Annex lounge close to student-engagement offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center’s official directory lists the Red Hawk Nest as lounge space in Room 126 of the Annex.
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Student Center Annex; observe building access rules.

cards.title: Commuter Commons
cards.subtitle: Student Center, third floor
cards.notes: Use the third-floor commons for a break or informal meetup, and take advantage of the adjacent lounge’s charging stations, TV, and seating.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor Student Center space alongside a lounge with charging stations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center directory lists Commuter Commons on the third floor and identifies an adjacent lounge with charging stations and TV.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Student Center; observe building access rules.

cards.title: Student Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Campus fitness, wellness, and recreation facility
cards.notes: Bring your valid university ID to use the gym, track, fitness areas, courts, lounges, or scheduled recreation programs; check the facility page for current operations.
cards.short_summary: A recreation facility with fitness space, courts, track, pool, lounges, and equipment lending.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair’s admissions page identifies the Student Recreation Center as the campus fitness, health, and wellness hub and lists its courts, fitness areas, track, pool, and lounges.
cards.access_notes: Admission is free to students with a valid Montclair State University ID.

cards.title: Student Recreation Center Pool
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center aquatics facility
cards.notes: Plan an open-swim visit with your university ID and follow the facility rules; no reservation is required for the posted general open-swim sessions.
cards.short_summary: A six-lane indoor pool offering general open swim.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation states that the pool offers general open swim without a reservation and requires a valid Montclair State University ID for facility entry.
cards.access_notes: General open swim is for students, faculty, staff, and alumni members; valid university ID required to enter the facility.
